parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term for product name, SKU, WPID, or UPC

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by (prefix with - for descending, e.g. -productName). Available: id, sku, productName, priceAmount, publishedStatus, lifecycleStatus

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Include archived products: 0 = active only, 1 = archived only

parameters.name: excluded
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of columns to exclude
